name: Sea breeze
notes: Wind model #10: 11-16 kn, oscillation +/-5 deg, a persistent trend of 5-15 deg one way, building up to 15 %; regular, mild (+20 %) puffs, few lulls. #221 overrides #10's period of about 120 s: the trend carries the race, with a quick oscillation of about 60 s on top, the shortest period the 30 s knots draw cleanly (ADR 0001).
Units: knots, degrees, seconds, metres; gains, losses, shares, coverage, build, ramps and drift as fractions.

The trend is the net shift over overSeconds from the gun, the 16-minute time limit; the build is the total rise in strength over its overSeconds as a fraction of base strength, capped so the wind never goes above the top of the strength range (#75: the forecast is never wrong). The race seed picks neither: the keyed wind does (ADR 0001).

Version 2 (schema 2, #75) is version 1 plus the keyed wind's tuning. wobbleDegrees is the peak of the smaller, faster wobble (#10) each 30 s window's key draws on top of the oscillation, vanishing at the window's knots. rampFraction is the longest the trend's shift, or the build's rise (the strength channel), may take, as a fraction of its overSeconds: the key chain draws that longest duration in the range and a start so it ends within overSeconds of the gun, and each 30 s window's key draws the pace, so the change finishes between half and all of that duration after it starts.

Version 3 (#221, #233) is version 2 with only three values changed: the period 60-65 s (was 110-130 s), the wobble 2 deg (was 0.6 deg), readable but never outlasting its 30 s window, and the puff fan 6 deg (was 4 deg), about 1.5 x, so a puff can decide which tack is favoured. The amplitude, trend, build and every other puff column are unchanged.

Placeholders (JSON Pointers above) await tuning on the #232 sliders: the 60-65 s period, the 2 deg wobble and the 6 deg fan (#221), the trend's 960 s span and 0.5-1 ramp, the build's 0 minimum (#10 says only up to 15 %), 960 s span and 0.5-1 ramp, and the other puff columns, set from #10's words (regular, mild, few lulls) and its shared ranges (60-150 m, puffs +20-35 %, lulls -15-25 %, drift 0.3-0.5 x wind).
